| # Secure Flashing {#secure-flashing-1 .p_Heading1 style="page-break-after: avoid;"}      |                                                                                                                            |
+------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+

This document outlines the secure flashing procedures for RC40, emphasizing the critical security features designed to protect device integrity and intellectual property during the software (CB-ME, ASW, keyfile, unlockfile) update process. Adherence to these guidelines is paramount for maintaining the security posture of products.

The product security features are designed to address the following EU regulations and standards:

- Machinery Regulation (MR) - EU 2023/1230

- Cyber Resilience Act (CRA) - EU 2024/2847

- Agricultural machinery, tractors, and earth-moving machinery -- Product cybersecurity ISO 24882

- EN 40000

The features are available in the below versions:

BSW: BSW V01.29-bs, WF s/ml 290-bs and onwards

CB-ME: rbr_CB_ME_S_V01.10.00 and onwards in RC40small, rbr_CB_ME_ML_V03.11.00 and onwards in RC40ML and rbr_CB_ME_ML_E_V01.04.00 and onwards in RC40ML Ethernet.
